title: Component runtime plumbing: emit placed v2 components into SWF (synthetic sprite + linkage + registerClass DoInitAction)
description: PART 1 DONE (plumbing). Placed v2 components are no longer dropped from the SWF. New compiler/components.ts runComponentPass(): for each ComponentItem PLACED on any scene/symbol timeline, synthesizes an empty DefineSprite registered in charIdMap under the ComponentItem.id (so the stage SymbolInstance resolves via the existing charIdMap.get(symbolId) frame-loop path — no frames.ts change), appends an ExportAssets entry under the fully-qualified AS2 class name (packageName+'.'+componentName, e.g. mx.controls.Button), and a DoInitAction calling Object.registerClass(linkageId, ClassName) via existing encodeDoInitAction. Wired in compile.ts after runSymbolPass / before runFrameLoop; export+init entries merged into the existing first-frame emission machinery. Added optional ComponentItem.linkage (ComponentLinkage{className,linkageIdentifier?}) in core types + exported from model/index. Test: packages/swf/src/__tests__/component-place.test.ts (3 tests) decodes our OWN compiled SWF and asserts (a) DefineSprite for the component, (b) ExportAssets lists mx.controls.Button, (c) DoInitAction registers the class (Object.registerClass bytecode), (d) stage PlaceObject2 references the synthetic sprite char id; plus unplaced-component-emits-nothing and explicit-className-override. VERIFY: pnpm --filter './packages/**' build => Done(0). pnpm --filter @flash/swf test --run => 112 files, 1385 passed. pnpm --filter @flash/core test --run => 5295 passed; only the 3 task-1207 missing fixtures/flash8-empty.fla failures (empty-bytematch, carchive-validate, contents-structure) — accepted. (largetimeline.test.ts is a perf flake under parallel load; passes in isolation.) OUT OF SCOPE/Part 2: real mx.controls.* AS2 framework/skins/behavior — components register as placeholders (accepted). docs/13 updated.
